requirements: You will manage a team of two to five payroll professionals and be accountable for accurate, timely, and compliant payroll for a fast-scaling workforce
This is not a coordinator role with a manager title. We need someone who has been in the engine room, knows what good looks like, and can build it here
Individual will not be ‘back office’ this is a business facing role and enhancing employee experience and stakeholder management is key
Manage the payroll calendar, cut-off deadlines, and coordination with HR and Finance to ensure data integrity from hire to final pay
Work with our Payroll GPO and Leadership team to build Data and AI enabled payroll operations
Good understanding of requirements outside the payslip (such as PSA and STBV in UK) and able to input and work with relevant teams to ensure compliance

title: Strategy and Analytics Business Partner
summary: Communicate with executives: Create narratives and documents that tell the story of your business area to influence senior Product, Engineering and Sales leadership and Stripe executive team decision making.
requirements: Conduct internal knowledge sharing sessions to strengthen the team
Bachelor's degree in STEM major (i.e. Computer Science, Math, Stat, Engineering, etc.) and 4+ years of prior working experience in data analysis fields
Strong analytical ability, proficiency with SQL (minimum of 3 years advanced SQL) and strong understanding of data relationships
Experience working with extremely large datasets
Experience with AI tools (Claude Code, etc.) and have demonstrated measurable impact from AI in your role or in others’ around you
Outstanding communication, presentation skills & stakeholder management skills

title: Chief Marketing Officer, Factor Europe
summary: Factor is the #1 ready-to-eat brand for people who see personal health as a key ingredient to achieving their goals.
requirements: Grow the partnerships network. Expand our rolodex of influencers and strategic partners that feed the acquisition engine
Lead creative with a clear point of view. Oversee creative functions and set a direction for how Factor shows up for customers
Partner with finance. Work with finance on business planning, forecasting, and end-to-end customer retention
Prepare new growth channels. Build toward new distribution channels such as retail and B2B over the next 12 to 18 months, establishing revenue lines beyond direct-to-consumer
Build and lead a lean, high-performing team. Create clear accountability and keep the organization flat, adding capacity only where the opportunity is clear
Senior marketing leadership at a scaled European subscription or e-commerce brand , with a track record of growing new customer volume at efficient acquisition costs

title: Legal Counsel
summary: Run the legal check on every new contract and renewal: SaaS terms, MSAs, DPAs, order forms and vendor agreements, with AI handling the first pass.
requirements: Build the function: a register of every contract and obligation, a ticketing flow, playbooks and plain-language customer terms
Qualified to practise law in Spain, with 5 to 7 years post-qualification on a law firm foundation. In-house years at a tech or SaaS company are a big plus
Working depth in GDPR: DPAs, records of processing, data subject requests and breach handling
French or Italian; experience as the only or first lawyer in a company; Spanish corporate housekeeping; daily use of AI tools in legal work
An international team of 35+ nationalities based in one of Europe's leading tech hubs

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (Armenia 🇦🇲)
summary: Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up.
requirements: Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t
So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR
Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond

As Alan enters the Armenian market, we need to build a strong team on the ground, fast, without lowering the bar. As our recruiter in Armenia, you will have a massive impact on Alan's talent density there

You'll drive hiring streams end to end in Armenia, working with the Alaners (your colleagues!) who hire and interview, and teach them how to be great recruiters. You move fast, with a lot of ownership
